canonical_project: 珑腾凉山州AI数据中心项目 (Longteng Liangshan AI Data Center)
owner: 盐腾数据 / 珑腾数据-related project company
notes: Reported in final pre-operation construction push in Yanyuan County, Liangshan. Total investment RMB35bn; total IT installed capacity 150MW. Phase 1 RMB8bn, D01 data center plus 220kV substation, 2,500 server cabinets and 500 network cabinets, 30MW IT load and 40,000P compute; phase 2 adds 120MW IT load and 160,000P.
